decision.reason: [ev-e7cf2f463686] says only that "ServiceAccount annotations" are now run through Helm `tpl`. It never names a values key path, and nothing in the section context names one either. The validator found that `serviceAccount.annotations` is not in any chart's default values; only its parent section is. So the evidence does not show whether the change covers only `serviceAccount.annotations` or other ServiceAccount annotation keys in the chart too. Deciding the subject needs the chart diff or values.yaml/template change from PR #7501. The change type behavior-changed is plausible, since `tpl` now renders values that were set before, but it cannot be locked in until the subject is known.
